disclaimers: Poll worker rates only; student-worker track ($50) excluded from the adult poll-worker range
disclosure_of_risks: Long Election Day (15+ hours); mandatory training attendance required
guarantees_or_promises: none - per-day county poll worker pay schedule
objective_evidence: County Poll Worker Manual pay table
party: York County, Pennsylvania, Elections and Voter Registration Office (county)

standard.s3: Per-day flat rates plus training stipend: Judge of Elections $175 + $25 training attendance (+ mileage for returns); Majority/Minority Inspector $150 + $25 training; Clerk $150 + $25 training; Machine Inspector $150 + $25 training; half-day shifts (clerks/machine inspectors) $75; high-school student workers $50 + $25 training. Training stipend is $25 per election-worker training attended. Constables are NOT poll workers per the manual and are excluded from these rates.
standard.s4: Must be a registered voter in York County (17+ high school students eligible with parent/guardian and principal permission); government officials/employees ineligible; mandatory training (in-person or online) before each election.
standard.s5: Official manual: poll workers arrive by 6:00 AM, polls open 7:00 AM; clerks and machine inspectors may work full or half day (half day 6:00-1:30 or 1:30-9:00 or close); judges and inspectors must work the full day through closing and returns delivery.
standard.s6: Full Election Day estimated ~6:00 a.m.-~9:00 p.m. (approx 14-15 hours including setup and closing); training time per session not stated in the manual.
